title: Semicontinuity for families of power series II
summary: The present article is a generalization of our paper \cite{GP21}, together with new applications. The original problem came up in connection with the classification of singularities in positive characteristic. Then it is important that certain invariants cannot increase if we deform a given singularity. In \cite{GP21} we proved this for the completed fiber dimension under deformations with section.
